title: setup writes a [coordination] setting nothing reads
what: setup stops writing [coordination]; the README row goes; a migration removes the section from existing kit.toml files with one line; doctor does not ask for it.
why: Found by the front 30 Oct while answering the owner ("что такое leadless coordination"): lib/relay_setup.py:205 writes [coordination] mode = "leadless" into every project's kit.toml and plugins/relay/README.md:203 documents three values (leadless, single-lead, multi-lead), but no code in lib, bin or the plugin hooks reads coordination.mode (grep, 30 Oct); docs/handover.md already says the key is unused. A setting that does nothing misleads the owner and every newcomer (principles 3 and 7).
failing_case: `relay setup` in a fresh repo writes [coordination] mode = "leadless" into .claude/kit.toml; `grep -rn coordination lib bin plugins/*/hooks` finds no reader besides relay_setup.py.
pass_cases: an existing kit.toml loses it with one line
